verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs/changelog show an environment selector dropdown, global environment variable overrides, and secret-manager integration, all pointing to a working multi-environment variable system, but there is no explicit walkthrough or hands-on confirmation of switching between named dev/staging/prod sets. missing for 10: dedicated docs page on creating/managing multiple named environments, independent/hands-on verification of switching behavior, and confirmation of per-environment secret scoping.
